data.text: The modelTombs.yml file allows you to configure custom 3D entity graves instead of standard player heads.
Below there is an index of all sections of modelTombs.yml.
To use model graves you need to enable the entity feature in config.yml:
You can create custom models with tools like BDEngine (https://bdengine.app) or find ideas on https://block-display.com.
Each model contains a summon command using block/item display entities. The plugin automatically refactors coordinates for correct placement.
This is a copy of the full modelTombs.yml file, updated to the latest version.
